notes.title: Announcing Update Version 1.2.0
notes.content:
[p]Hello, this is the development team.
Thank you for playing "Sofia in Exchange for Lies".[/p][p]In this update, we have fixed an issue where the game could not start on systems with AMD hardware, resulting in an error.[/p][p]Additionally, we have resolved the issue where certain keywords were not recognized correctly when playing in English or Simplified Chinese, causing players to be unable to progress in the game.[/p][p]We apologize for the time it took to resolve these issues.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]■ Adjustments[/b][/h3][p]To make the game more enjoyable, we’ve made the following adjustments:[/p][p]● Added some keywords to make certain events easier to discover
● Fixed an issue where the log screen would close when scrolling with the mouse wheel
● Adjusted some in-game text to make it easier to understand the next question to ask[/p][p][/p][h3][b]■ Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][p]We’ve fixed the following issues:[/p][p]● The game could crash on AMD-based PCs
● The "Change Date" event could be triggered during the first playthrough
● In English and Simplified Chinese, some text in the Investigation Log couldn’t be copied
● In English and Simplified Chinese, certain keywords required to progress the conversation could not be found
● In English, some keywords could lead to multiple events being triggered
● In certain cases, the "Change Date" event would not occur
● In certain cases, some achievements could not be unlocked
※ If the "Case Files Complete" achievement is not unlocking, please follow these steps:[/p][p]　1. Restart from Day 1 with a new playthrough 　　
　2. Skip through Amy's conversation by asking the "Special Question" 　　
　3. Clear Q1 with Sofia without asking the "Special Question" 　　
　4. With Sofia, search for "Ghost Square," then ask the question "The Hut by the Ghost Plaza" [/p][p]● In certain cases, speaker names may not display correctly
● In certain cases, some blocks on the Keyword Map may remain locked
● Some animations were not behaving correctly
● Right-clicking the text input box in the Talk Screen caused input issues
※ With this fix, right-clicking will no longer display a context menu in the input box
※ Text copied from the Investigation Log can still be pasted with "Ctrl+V"[/p][p]● Minor other fixes[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your continued support of "Sofia in Exchange for Lies".[/p]

notes.title: Announcing Update Version 1.1.0
notes.content:
[p]Hello, this is the development team.
Thank you for playing [b]"Sofia in Exchange for Lies"[/b].[/p][p]This update introduces the much-requested [b]Advance the Date[/b] feature.
We’ve also fixed an issue where certain questions could not be asked when playing in English or Simplified Chinese.[/p][p]In addition, several other updates have been made to improve overall gameplay.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]■ New Feature[/b][/h3][p]A new system has been added to allow players to advance to the next day.[/p][p]During a second playthrough, entering the keyword "Change date" in the Talk Screen will display the option to proceed to the next day.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45335417/3ce47e846dcced47c43b2e614204a18125421597.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]■ Adjustments[/b][/h3][p]The following changes have been made to improve playability:[/p][p]● Added hints to certain blocks in the Keyword Map
● Added some keywords to appear as hints in the Log Screen
● Adjusted hint display in the Question Screen and Keyword Map
● Extended the camera's left-right movement range for better room visibility
● Increased the occurrence rate of some conversations to make specific gifts easier to give
● Adjusted volume for certain voice lines to improve clarity
● Updated the layout of some keywords in the Keyword Map[/p][p][/p][h3][b]■ Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][p]The following issues have been fixed:[/p][p]● Some keywords were not recognized correctly in the English and Simplified Chinese versions
Affected keyword: "Strict"
● Some Keyword Map text differed from the actual dialogue
Examples:
- Incorrect: He even sent a picture. → Correct: He even sent a photo.
- Incorrect: So I called him. → Correct: So I decided to contact him.
● Story scenes could be skipped under certain conditions
● Incorrect events could play under specific conditions
● Some keywords in the Keyword Map could remain locked under certain conditions
● Jump Words could become unusable under certain conditions
● Character models may not display properly at specific timings
● The Investigation Log detail section may fail to open in some cases
● Incorrect unlock conditions for some achievements
● Some UI text appeared hard to read when playing in Simplified Chinese
● Some character animations did not play correctly
● Minor text and translation issues
● Other small bugs[/p][p][/p][h3][b]■ Known Issues[/b][/h3][p]We have confirmed the following known issues:[/p][p]● The game may crash on startup when using AMD-based PCs
Please refer to the following announcement for more information:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3326660/view/546739082808528703"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]● In certain scenes, even when the "Change Date" event plays, the date does not actually change
● In the English and Simplified Chinese versions, some elements of the Investigation Log may not display properly, and copying keywords may not function as intended[/p][p][/p][p]All of these issues are scheduled to be fixed in the next update.
Thank you for your continued support of [b]"Sofia in Exchange for Lies"[/b].[/p]
